handoff_instructions: Re-applied the saved wip patch (each file well under the per-file limit) and finished PH-T03: migration 0019_document_storage.sql creates a private 'documents' Storage bucket with org-scoped RLS policies (storage_object_org_id() derives the org from the object's path prefix; member-read, owner/office_admin/manager write/update/delete, matching the existing public.documents policy shape) plus a check constraint tying documents.storage_path to its own organization_id. Added a DocumentStorageProvider interface (packages/integrations) with a FakeDocumentStorageProvider for tests/fake mode and a SupabaseDocumentStorageProvider adapter for live mode (short-lived signed URLs only, no direct file access); wired into createProviderRuntime via new SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY/DOCUMENT_STORAGE_BUCKET env vars. Added core's requestDocumentDownload(ctx, documentId): authorizes with a new document.download permission, tenant-scopes the lookup, and writes a document.downloaded audit record; minting the actual signed URL is left to the caller with the returned storage path (core stays provider-independent per CLAUDE.md rules 9-10). New tests in packages/core/test/hardening/document-storage.test.ts prove cross-tenant reads/writes on storage.objects are rejected by RLS and that requestDocumentDownload both audits successful downloads and blocks + does not audit cross-tenant attempts; packages/core/test/helpers/supabase-shim.sql got a minimal storage.buckets/storage.objects stand-in so the real migration SQL runs against the test DB. format:check, lint, typecheck and the full test suite (pnpm test, including workflow/test/referee.test.mjs) all pass. Nothing left for PH-T03; next is PH-T04 (monitoring and alerting hooks).
